stories.title: Carney reports progress in trade talks with Trump days before US midterms
stories.summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney said he had a 'good conversation' with President Trump on trade and that teams will work 'in the coming weeks' toward a deal, a possible thaw in the two countries' tariff war days before the US midterms.

stories.title: Russia arrests minor after US embassy warns of credible mass-casualty threat
stories.summary: Russia's FSB detained a minor it says was planning an attack, a day after the US Embassy in Moscow warned of a 'credible threat of a mass casualty event' at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve.

stories.title: At least eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza
stories.summary: At least eight Palestinians, including a four-year-old boy, were killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza, hospital sources said, the latest deaths despite a year-old ceasefire.

stories.title: Iran's supreme leader warns of 'geographically unrestricted' response to any new US attack
stories.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered military commanders to meet any new US or Israeli attack with an 'immediate, impactful, and geographically unrestricted' response, warning the conflict could spread beyond the Middle East.

stories.title: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents
stories.summary: Google is opening Android development to third-party AI agents and rolling out new Gemini APIs, letting external coding assistants build for Android alongside Google's own tools.

stories.title: Karpathy's HackerTube plays only videos recommended on Hacker News
stories.summary: Andrej Karpathy released HackerTube, a YouTube that plays only videos recommended across Hacker News, and it quickly topped the HN front page.

stories.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow integrate agentic AI workflows
stories.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow expanded their partnership to integrate agentic AI workflows across the platform, deepening enterprise AI-agent automation.

stories.title: DeepSeek open-sources Super-Agent, a coding agent that reads team chats
stories.summary: DeepSeek open-sourced Super-Agent, a coding agent that watches developers' group chats and proactively suggests fixes without being summoned, aimed at rivaling Anthropic's Claude Code.

stories.title: Watson exits after helmet-to-helmet hit; Sanders takes over at QB
stories.summary: Browns QB Deshaun Watson left the game after a helmet-to-helmet hit by Jaquan Brisker on the opening drive, with Shedeur Sanders taking over under center.

stories.title: Browns get Howard back, elevate Ryan ahead of Steelers showdown
stories.summary: Tytus Howard cleared concussion protocol and the Browns elevated rookie TE Carsen Ryan, leaving the roster nearly intact for the AFC North clash at Pittsburgh.

stories.title: Browns look to end 22-year winless streak in Pittsburgh
stories.summary: The Browns entered Sunday's game in Pittsburgh trying to snap a 22-year regular-season winless streak in that building and take control of the AFC North.

stories.title: Ryan Day backs freshman QB Fahey after loss at USC
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day said freshman QB Luke Fahey's first start at USC was 'a tough situation,' after the Buckeyes fell 30-18 with starter Julian Sayin sidelined.

stories.title: Buckeyes' CFP hopes on thin ice after 30-18 loss at USC
stories.summary: Ohio State's 30-18 loss at USC dropped the Buckeyes to 6-2 and left their College Football Playoff hopes on thin ice with backup quarterback play, their second loss before November since 2011.

stories.title: What we learned from Ohio State's loss to USC
stories.summary: Ohio State fell 30-18 at USC on a rainy night in Los Angeles, a defeat that puts the Buckeyes' College Football Playoff path in serious jeopardy.

stories.title: Mexico City GP live coverage underway as Antonelli chases youngest title
stories.summary: Formula 1's live coverage of the Mexico City Grand Prix is underway, with Kimi Antonelli aiming to become the youngest champion in the sport's history.

stories.title: Antonelli needs just ninth place in Mexico to be F1's youngest champion
stories.summary: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli needs only a ninth-place finish at the Mexico City GP to become F1's youngest ever world champion, breaking a record set in 2010.

stories.title: Sunday Briefing previews the Ohio governor's race
stories.summary: NBC4's Sunday Briefing previews the Ohio governor's race between Democrat Amy Acton and Republican Vivek Ramaswamy, one of the nation's most-watched contests ahead of Tuesday's election.

stories.title: Reynoldsburg man sentenced in shootout, still faces murder charge
stories.summary: A Reynoldsburg man was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison for a shootout with officers in Springfield, while still facing a murder charge in a 2025 north Columbus homicide.

stories.title: Police search for suspect in fatal shooting of teenager
stories.summary: Columbus police are searching for a suspect after a teenager was fatally shot, as officers investigate the city's latest homicide.
